articles.title: SOLANA FOUNDATION ACQUIRES MAJORITY STAKE IN COINGECKO
articles.summary: The Solana Foundation acquired a majority stake in CoinGecko, the leading crypto data platform founded in Malaysia in 2014 by Bobby Ong and TM Lee, which serves tens of millions of monthly users and 180,000 developers and businesses with pricing and market data. Post-acquisition plans include integrating Solana-native trading and DeFi experiences directly into the platform and expanding CoinGecko's coverage to equities and real-world assets. The deal gives Solana direct distribution to CoinGecko's developer and API base, positioning the chain as the primary DeFi execution layer for the platform's next product phase.

articles.title: COINBASE LAUNCHES OFFICIAL CHATGPT PLUGIN FOR AGENTIC TRADING
articles.summary: Coinbase has launched a ChatGPT plugin that lets users connect their Coinbase account to trade stocks, crypto, and derivatives without leaving the chat interface. Users retain approval authority over each order, keeping execution within the existing conversation flow. This is the first app in the ChatGPT plugin store that enables financial transactions.

articles.title: COINFLOW SPEND: SETTLE INSTANTLY, SPEND ANYWHERE, EARN 2% CASH BACK
articles.summary: Coinflow Spend allows merchant revenue to settle into a Coinflow balance in seconds, 24/7. Merchants can issue virtual cards to employees with individual limits, topped up from that balance. The cards work anywhere Visa is accepted. Transactions are exportable for accounting. Qualified spending will earn uncapped 2% cash back until March 31.

articles.title: STREET: BOARD-ALIGNED PRIVATE EQUITY SECONDARY MARKETPLACE
articles.summary: Street launched out of stealth as a board-aligned private equity secondary marketplace, disclosing $200M in open interest on day one. CEO Lukas Gruber cited OpenAI and Anthropic's public disclosures that billions in their secondary sales were illicit and voided, and that 5 of 6 major secondary platforms had closed transactions without board knowledge, as the catalyst for building a compliant alternative. Street has partnered with Google and established capital allocators to deliver a brokerage-style experience rather than a traditional secondary marketplace. The company's stated long-term goal is to become the American Exchange for Private Equity, competing with SPV-based structures that have dominated private secondary markets.

articles.title: HOW TOKENIZED DEPOSITS ACTUALLY SETTLE
articles.summary: Tokenized deposits like Citi Token Services and JPMorgan's Kinexys are “on-us,” staying within one bank's legal entity. Moving them between banks requires interbank settlement, since the receiving bank otherwise holds an unsecured claim on the sender. Swift's Shared Ledger locks the deposit and lets the receiving bank credit immediately, but settlement is deferred through RTGS, leaving credit exposure in between. Issuing a tokenized deposit on an internal ledger is necessary but not sufficient for better interbank settlement.

articles.title: BEYOND THE BOT: MAPPING THE AGENTIC TRADING STACK
articles.summary: The agentic trading space can be mapped into four layers: Intelligence (data and market reasoning models), Agency (harnesses, terminals, and copilots), Execution (venue connectivity), and Compliance and Observability (trust infrastructure for autonomous decisions). In the Agency layer, OpenClaw accumulated ~250K GitHub stars in 60 days, with trading-specialized harnesses like Senpi and Supertake and cross-asset terminals such as Catalyst competing across stocks, options, and prediction markets. The agent itself carries no moat, since open-source models on open-source harnesses commoditize agent capability, placing value with whoever owns the decision loop (Intent-as-a-Service), platforms with the deepest liquidity, and custodians trusted across the broadest asset class range. Coinbase Ventures is investing across three pillars: harnesses and terminals that deliver portfolio-building intent, proprietary intelligence and specialized market reasoning models, and compliance/observability infrastructure covering agent identity and tamper-proof decision logs.

articles.title: CHATGPT WALLET IS THE RIGHT BET ON THE WRONG TIMELINE
articles.summary: OpenAI chose network agentic tokens, the right long-term approach, but incentives aren't aligned yet. Users get a worse experience (credit cards only, Face ID on every purchase, and thin recurring support). Merchants still carry dispute risk with no network liability framework, and one in three of 174 top stores couldn't reach guest checkout in one test. Issuers approve blind, with no standard view of intent and no answer on who absorbs chargebacks, and Visa expects agentic commerce to stay small through FY2027. OpenAI isn't taking a cut yet and lacks an Apple Pay-style deal. One should expect a fallback to raw card details in the near term.

articles.title: IF I WERE BUILDING A NEOBANK TODAY
articles.summary: The post communicates 30 principles for a new neobank. Chief among them: go B2B for $50M+ revenue businesses in boring, cash-rich niches, with distribution as the only moat, credit products and underwriting as defensibility, and lending your own capital for higher margins. Dominate one industry first, choose the sponsor bank carefully, support stablecoins from day one, obsess over onboarding speed and compliance, and avoid competing on cashback alone. The biggest competitor is JPMorgan, and it's not worth calling yourself a neobank.

articles.title: FORMER UK PM MANGLES SATOSHI'S NAME ON CAMERA
articles.summary: Former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson repeatedly mangled Bitcoin creator Satoshi Nakamoto's pseudonym on camera, referring to him as "Yakko-Mucko Nakasako" and "Yakamoto Nakasori" while conceding that nobody knows who controls Bitcoin.
